notes: send out kept whole with שְׁלַח under rule 44 on the footing of find out / gather together, with the added reading for out named in the note.
Explicit הֵמָּה takes only them; the let frame goes to the jussive יַנְחוּ (rule 17), while the second jussive with no explicit pronoun takes Let them bring whole.
הַר־קָדְשְׁךָ rendered attributively: hill to the construct, holy to the rectum (rule 28), thy to the suffix.
